criteria.criterion: On a scratch unfiltered clone, the rewritten branch commit count equals the measured old-tip commit count.
On the same clone, the rewritten branch merge-commit count equals the measured old-tip merge-commit count.
Before rewrite, the harness asserts `git ls-tree -r --name-only <old-tip> -- .bridge_state.bak-retarget/` has empty stdout, proving the recorded old tip includes closed B6.
The re-add set comes from `ls-tree`, proven by a synthetic store with a fourth `.bridge_state/` file that survives byte-identically.

The rewritten branch has no commit touching `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/`; the harness executes `test -z "$(git log --format=%H rewritten-tickets -- .bridge_state.bak-retarget/)"`. Tier: repo integration.
A fresh unfiltered `--no-tags` clone of the rewritten branch has pack size at most 150 MB; harness first asserts `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` is absent before pack measurement.
An adversarial commit message whose first line begins with `M ` survives byte-identically. Tier: unit stream-filter test.
The script refuses a `--filter=blob:none` clone with a nonzero exit. Tier: integration.
That refusal writes an operator-readable remedy requiring a fresh unfiltered clone. Tier: integration.
Every graph, tree, history-removal, and pack-size assertion completes before the script produces its final success result. Tier: integration with a seeded assertion failure.
A completed dry run invokes no remote push operation. Tier: integration with a recording Git wrapper.
A completed dry run leaves the source remote `tickets` ref unchanged. Tier: repo integration comparing the exact before/after object id.
A completed dry run leaves source remote tag `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` unchanged. Tier: repo integration comparing the exact before/after object id.
In temporary real clones rooted at the rewritten branch, the harness appends and pushes one representative review-bot ticket event. Tier: repo integration.
After that synthetic writer push, `git merge-base --is-ancestor <old-tip> <new-tip>` exits nonzero. Tier: repo integration.
The representative writer push increases incremental `size-pack` by less than 1 MB. Tier: repo integration.
